fowl run.d: an enclosed yard for keeping poultry

fowling piece.d: a light shotgun used for fowling

fowl pest.d: either of two acute viral diseases of domestic fowl; characterized by refusal to eat and high temperature and discoloration of the comb

fowl cholera.d: an acute diarrheal disease (especially of chickens) caused by the microorganism that causes hemorrhagic septicemia

fowler.d: English lexicographer who wrote a well-known book on English usage (1858-1933)
